messages:
joanne_pm: thinking about the rollout console — we need an "auto-escape hatch" UI that makes it obvious when an auto-fallback has been triggered and why. current mockups feel too buried.

sam_engineer: +1. main ask: surface the trigger and the active degrade mode. engineers want a quick way to see whether it was latency, error-rate, or token-exhaustion.

lee_infra: to be concrete, triggers we currently support: 5xx error rate, p95 latency, queued requests, model oom, and explicit capacity signals from Dedicated. we also have reserve/capacity-tier fallbacks.

dave_ux: can we show a single concise status line in the route header: e.g. `AUTO-ESCAPE: active — mode=graceful-throttle, trigger=p95>600ms` and then a collapsible timeline for more detail? avoids modal noise.

sam_engineer: timeline should include the decision chain: what rule matched, what matched first, and what fallback model or region was chosen. we need deterministic replay for postmortems.

joanne_pm: replay is critical. product wants: who initiated (auto vs manual), which policy version, exact input metrics, and the fallback mapping. immutable audit entry.

lee_infra: backend already emits an opaque audit blob for each decision. we need a small agreed schema to render: {policy_id, policy_version, trigger_metric, trigger_value, chosen_variant, routed_region, reason_code}.

dave_ux: put that schema in the UI but hide by default. show human-readable line + an action: "Copy decision JSON" and "Open replay in simulator".

sam_engineer: the "Open replay" should accept a time window and the original request prefix (kv cache) — otherwise replays aren't realistic. also needs to indicate whether fallback used quantized variant or smaller model.

joanne_pm: what about alerting matrix? ops want noise control — only page on critical degradations. product wants slack + severity tags.

lee_infra: propose thresholds: INFO -> slack channel; WARN -> on-call inbox; CRITICAL -> page. mapping controlled by rollout policy's "notification_policy" field.

dave_ux: add a compact badge color on the route list: green/yellow/red and a tooltip with latest trigger + short reason. click-through to timeline.

sam_engineer: edge case: cascading fallbacks (region -> model size -> embedding-only). UI should show chain, not just final state, otherwise debugging is impossible.

joanne_pm: agree. also need an escape hatch for SREs: a single-button "force-stop-auto-escape" that doesn't mutate the policy but suppresses auto-activations for N minutes and creates an audit entry. must be restricted by role.

lee_infra: implementation note: suppression is orthogonal to policy — it's a runtime override with TTL and a reference tag. we'll log suppressor, ttl, and reason.

rollout-bot: automated-check: policy-ui-compat v0.9 passed. small schema mismatch: UI expects `trigger_value` number, backend sends string for `p95` (e.g., "620ms"). failing safe parse suggested.

dave_ux: UI can parse units, but let's normalize at the API layer. consistent types make UX decisions easier.

sam_engineer: we should also capture sample request IDs in the audit entry (redacted) so QA can pull the exact prompt. privacy filter: redact PII and keep prompt hash + sanitized text.

joanne_pm: timeline/telemetry question: how long should audit records be kept? compliance suggested 1 year, but cost ops prefer 90 days for hot storage. propose: 90 days hot, 1 year archived.

lee_infra: that's our current default. add a checkbox in the policy UI: "retain debug logs for X days (90/365)" with note about storage costs.

sam_engineer: small API debate: should policy versions be immutable? i.e., edits create a new version. i vote yes — simplifies audits.

dave_ux: versioning fits the UI: show version history and a diff viewer for rules. plus a "preview rollouts" sandbox button.

joanne_pm: next actions: sam to PR the normalized audit schema, lee to expose suppression endpoints with RBAC, dave to update mockups with chain view + header badge, i'll coordinate product notes and compliance ask.

sam_engineer: i'll drop the schema draft in #eng-platform later today.

lee_infra: I'll add suppression API spec to the infra board.

dave_ux: mockups by next Wed, will include a small clipboardable JSON sample for the audit entry.

joanne_pm: great. quick follow-up: should the UI surface suggested mitigations (e.g., lower concurrency, route to cheaper quantized model) inline? or keep suggestions separate?

sam_engineer: helpful to show suggestions from Optimize engine, but mark as "recommendation" — operator still chooses.

dave_ux: we'll render recommendations as a small panel with "apply" buttons that open the rollout sandbox. low friction.

joanne_pm: perfect. thanks all. I'll file a short RFC doc and link mocks + schema when available. :thumbsup:

rollout-bot: RFC created: https://r3dwood.internal/rfcs/2742 (auto-escape-hatch-ui).
